data.name: Anabal
data.long_meaning: Anabal is a Greek name derived from the words ‘ana’ meaning ‘up’ and ‘ballein’ meaning ‘to throw’. The name Anabal signifies a graceful mountain, symbolizing strength and ascent. In Christian tradition, it may also represent the mountain of God, Mount Zion, where God's presence is most felt.
